lead.zh: 给靠文字吃饭的人：先懂 AI 怎么生成、哪里会错，再学会让它替你干活而不是替你编活。
lead.en: For people who make a living on words: first understand how AI generates and where it goes wrong, then make it work for you instead of inventing work for you.

zh: 说出幻觉的两种成因，各配一个写作场景里的例子
用「联网检索 + 自己核对」替代直接采信 AI 给的引用
拿到一段 AI 文字，说清哪些部分必须人工复核、复核什么
en: Name two causes of hallucination, each with an example from a writing scenario
Replace trusting AI-provided citations on faith with retrieval plus your own verification
Given a passage of AI text, say which parts require human review and what to check
